question: As per Census of India 2011, which of the following states has the highest percentage of urban population in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mizoram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the **Census of India 2011**, Mizoram has the highest percentage of **urban population** among all states in India.
 
• **Mizoram **has experienced significant **urbanization** over the decades, contributing to its high urban population.
 
• The state has robust **industrial development**, which has led to increased urban growth and migration to urban areas.
 
• **Infrastructure development** in terms of transportation, housing, and public amenities has also supported urbanization in Tamil Nadu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra**__

 __
 
• **Maharashtra** is one of the most urbanized states in India with major cities like **Mumbai, Pune, and Nagpur**.
 
• **Mumbai**, the capital city, is the financial hub of India.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat**__
 
 
• **Gujarat** has a significant urban population with key cities like **Ahmedabad, Surat, and Vadodara**.
 
• It is known for its **industrial and economic development**.
